rules.claim: the submitted system's 14-day zero-width gate on non-headline series (EVAL_PROTOCOL.md Amendment 3)
After exactly one median change in the preceding 14 days, the blend overstates the spread of the next day's price; contracting both tails by 25% will reduce pinball loss.

On active panels containing only one provider, excluding prov from the blend reduces pinball loss because provider-level repricing extrapolation lacks the stabilizing influence of offers from other providers.

On active panels containing exactly one offer, excluding fragility reduces pinball loss because its panel-based tail adjustment has no observed neighbouring offer to anchor to and can overweight the mix forecast already in the blend.
